algorithm.content: Use the pinned expected full row's bytes, SHA256 and working_blob. No source file was read or newly hashed by this projection.
algorithm.gzip: No gzip identity is predicted. Original b92 gzip headers can vary; the required inventory hash covers the uncompressed JSON array.
algorithm.membership: Original git ls-files plus nonignored untracked paths; in this pinned expected clean full inventory every physical file is indexed, so the union is exactly its 15188 paths.
algorithm.mode: Symlink => 120000; regular file => 100755 if any physical execute bit is set, otherwise 100644.
algorithm.serializer: json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode(); default ensure_ascii=True; no terminal LF.
algorithm.sort: Sort unique raw Git path bytes. All current paths are ASCII; source-relative path strings retain those bytes.

requirements_before_use: Root must receive the actual normal canonical-alignment terminal and complete audits.
Its actual full inventory identity must match this exact 5611184-byte input pin; a predicted tree alone is insufficient.
The reviewed native wrapper must still run its original source-before snapshot from the actual checkout and compare its own exact HEAD/tree/status/count/hash against the bound expected values.
The unchanged b92 focused/all drivers must still take and retain their own actual original snapshots and require before/after equality.

Source gates must first create and freeze their original shared/no-hardlinks independent clone. That clone's permissions/full-inventory hash can differ from the writable origin; do not substitute the clone hash.
Generated ignored JUnit/output files after native execution must remain explicit in the separate final full-physical observation.

scope_difference.full_5118: Object with source HEAD/tree/status, counts, and every physical source file plus every index entry. Rows retain permissions, kind, index mode/blob, working blob, stability and index-match flags; ignored physical outputs are visible. Serializer ends with LF.
scope_difference.native_b92_and_wrapper: Array of tracked and nonignored-untracked rows only. It omits ignored outputs and full permission/stability/index fields. Source HEAD/tree/status/count live in a separate summary. Array serializer has no LF.
scope_difference.not_substitutable: Full SHA256 df891018... and projected native SHA256 describe different byte formats and scope. Neither may be relabeled as the other.
